summary_hint: which provider generated the asset report, when it was generated/refreshed, whose accounts it covers, the total verified/available assets, and the per-account balances

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity — confirms this is an asset-verification report

typed_core.name: verification_provider_name
typed_core.why: identity — the aggregator that produced the report (the source of authority)

typed_core.name: report_generated_date_time
typed_core.why: identity/recency — when the report was produced (degraded from datetime)

typed_core.name: data_refresh_date_time
typed_core.why: disambiguator — as-of timestamp for the balances; a report can be generated later than its data was pulled (degraded from datetime)

typed_core.name: verification_method
typed_core.why: processor — direct/aggregation/manual; independence weight (degraded from enum)

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose assets; attaches to the borrower (flattened from person[])

typed_core.name: borrower_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — how many borrowers the report covers

typed_core.name: consent_or_authorization_reference
typed_core.why: processor — the borrower-consent record backing the pull (compliance review)

typed_core.name: total_available_assets
typed_core.why: processor — headline available/liquid total (may differ from verified)

nested_lists.name: verified_accounts
nested_lists.shape_reason: accounts genuinely repeat (a borrower can have several checking/savings/investment accounts across institutions) and this is the primary content of the report; a borrower rarely has more than ~10 accounts, but flat rows keep it well under the 16,384 ceiling and carry the masked account number cleanly

fields.name: account_number_masked
fields.why: identifies the account within the report
fields.pii_note: already in the 7-field _PII_FIELDS registry, pre_masked=true; carried inside the nested record with the standard redactor

fields.name: account_type
fields.why: account type (DDA/checking, SAV/savings, brokerage/investment) captured verbatim

fields.name: account_holder_name
fields.why: the per-account holder name for ownership review; may differ from the borrower (joint/third-party)

rejected.name: issuer_address / issuer_phone / issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: provider contact fields with no consumer

rejected.name: form_number / form_revision_date
rejected.reason: an aggregator report is not a standardized form

rejected.name: statement_period_start / statement_period_end
rejected.reason: the report is a point-in-time pull, not a statement period

rejected.name: party_names / party_addresses
rejected.reason: duplicate borrower_names; addresses have no consumer here

rejected.name: property_address / loan_number / account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not core to an asset report; catch-all captures loan_number if present

rejected.name: large_deposit_or_anomaly_flags
rejected.reason: a judgment, not a fact — flagging large deposits is a rule's job (from transactions); tags describe, rules judge

rejected.name: report_completeness_or_error_codes
rejected.reason: provider status codes with no consumer; catch-all captures

encoding_variations: "Verified" vs "available" vs "current" balance are three different numbers per account (available excludes holds; verified is the provider's attested figure) — keep all three per row; do not collapse
Generated vs refresh timestamps: some providers show only one, some both; the refresh time is the true as-of for balances and must not be overwritten by the generation time
Account type stated as "DDA"/"checking", "SAV"/"savings", "brokerage"/"investment" — capture the provider's label verbatim

Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

options: reconsider shape after a real sample
open_questions.recommendation: flat-row chosen for token safety; confirm against a real multi-institution report

notes: No rules read this document today (rule floor is empty); fields are justified by identity, disambiguation, PII, and processor use. A Verification of Assets is a third-party aggregator report (e.g. FormFree/AccountChek/Finicity); its value is confirming eligible funds and account ownership, and its trustworthiness depends on the generated/refresh timestamps.

These are aggregator reports; provider vocabulary (FormFree AccountChek, Finicity, Plaid Assets) with the report ID and timestamps in a header block. Account numbers are already masked to last-4 by the provider — capture as-is; never reconstruct a full number.
account_number_masked is already in the 7-field _PII_FIELDS registry, pre_masked=true; nothing new needs registration.
